role: The humanoid model every player, zombie, skeleton, pigman and villager render derives from: head, headwear, body, arms, legs, plus the ears and cloak extras and the held-item/aim/sneak pose flags.
scope_reason: The biped family is pixel-gated (mobs_zombie_*, mobs2b_villager_*, mobs2a_skeleton_*, and the first-person arm in hand_* scenes).

members.name: bipedHead
members.note: the head part of each biped model builder (model_player for the player, model_zombie and its variants for the mobs)

members.name: bipedHeadwear
members.note: the grow 0.5 hat box, drawn in every biped model

members.name: bipedEars
members.note: RenderPlayer draws them only for a player named deadmau5 (RenderPlayer.renderEquippedItems); the oracle's session is Player (Main.java's --username)

members.name: bipedCloak
members.note: RenderPlayer draws it only when AbstractClientPlayer.func_152122_n (a cape texture the skin manager fetched from the session server for the profile); the oracle's offline Player profile has none

members.name: heldItemLeft
members.note: no renderer in oracle/src sets it (grep heldItemLeft =), so the branch never runs

members.name: heldItemRight
members.note: bends the armour models' right arm; ModelZombie overrides it on the bodies

members.name: isSneak
members.note: RenderPlayer's sneak pose: the body 0.5, arms +0.4, legs at z 4 and y 9, the head at y 1 (mob_render_input.sneak)

members.name: aimedBow
members.note: ModelSkeleton sets it on the wither skeleton, then ModelZombie.setRotationAngles overrides both arms

members.name: ModelBiped
members.note: no caller in oracle/src: ModelZombie, ModelSkeleton, ModelEnderman and RenderPlayer construct through the (float) and (float,float,int,int) forms (lane/covframes)

members.name: ModelBiped
members.note: the armour models at grow 1.0 and 0.5 (model_player's grow)

members.name: ModelBiped
members.note: the offset and texture size variants (the villager's 64x64 in model_villager)

members.name: setRotationAngles
members.note: the legs' rotationPointZ 0.1 when not sneaking

members.name: (first-person arm, RenderPlayer.renderFirstPersonArm)
members.note: the right arm at its pivot with all setRotationAngles arguments 0, raster_hand.c:197 names it

notes: Native biped models exist per kind (zombie, villager, skeleton, pigman via hostiles_pigman's model use of the biped shape); the player's third-person body is not drawn (first person only). setRotationAngles and render are also ported for the inventory preview (raster_mobs.c raster_mobs_player_preview, gui_inventory_preview). lane/idxclient: the player's ModelBiped is model_player (heldItemRight 1 and the sword's 3, aimedBow, isSneak, isRiding, the swing), drawn in third person and asleep by RenderPlayer's path (MOB_PLAYER): idx-tpv-s1's third-person frames (walking, sneaking, the front view's swing, the sword block, the bow) within 16 to 358 px over 25, no pxdiff cluster.
